import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*x+params[3]*v+params[4]*x**2+params[5]*x**3+params[6]*x*v
            +params[7]*c+params[8]*s+params[9]*t*c)
